[ASSISTANT_SAID] The platform allows users to set up regular investments into a diversified portfolio of cryptocurrencies using a Dollar-Cost Averaging (DCA) strategy.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The platform offers a native token that can be staked for rewards and additional features, with a transparent fee structure and a commitment to user security.
